title: Alone Together
reception: Opening Friday, Oct 16, 2026, 5–8 pm, with live music
description: Six artists from different backgrounds and places, most of whom have never met: Angiola Churchill, Sydney Cash, Julie Lindell, Jan Mulder, Bix Lye and Paulien Lethen. The opening on Friday, Oct 16 had live music by Duo Laroo/Byrd: Saskia Laroo (trumpet, saxophone, bass, vocals) and Warren Byrd (piano, vocals, bongos).

about: Holland Tunnel Gallery is pleased to present Alone Together, an exhibition featuring six artists from different backgrounds and places, most of whom have never met.

Each artist's work stands on its own, yet the works find unexpected connections when brought together. The exhibition invites viewers to discover those connections, while appreciating what makes each work distinct.

statements.title: Italy
paragraphs: A latent visual artist, Angiola lived through exposure to scenes of our most significant modernist developments.
She passed away on June 16; she was 104 years old.

statements.title: USA
paragraphs: Julie is an installation artist. Her work examines the functions assigned to objects, and the forces that render them obsolete.

statements.title: England
paragraphs: “I like playing with colors, shapes and their relationship.”
He passed away in 2023; he was 86 years old.

statements.title: USA
paragraphs: Sydney's long-term interest in spirituality has been fundamental to his personal exploration of “seeing,” the intuitive basis of artistic creation.

statements.title: The Netherlands
paragraphs: “I waterwash the applied ink, still wet, off the paper. When dry, brush ink on, repeat, repeat, until I peek into an Asian landscape, a Northern darkness, a Southern light, or the alley around the corner.”

statements.title: The Netherlands
paragraphs: “My work is influenced by movement, and the places I lived: Holland, Greece, Japan and New York.”
